## Offer scope

Included in base (where the platform allows):
- Russian language in multimedia menus and settings

Optional (priced separately on site calculator):
- Yandex apps pack (Alice, Maps, Music) where technically possible: 220 BYN (most brands) / 450 BYN (Li Auto, Zeekr, Avatr)
- Software-update language protection subscription: 150 BYN
- On-site visit within Minsk: 100 BYN

Not offered:
- Mechanical repair / diagnostics of car systems
- Power chip-tuning
- Promising apps the head unit does not allow

Warranty: 6 months on completed menu rusification. Does not cover third-party flashes or dealer changes without agreement.

Payment: BYN on site / transfer / ERIP-style link from master. Online card checkout may be added later.

## Typical timing

- Most models: 40–60 minutes
- Complex (e.g. Zeekr, Li Auto): up to 2–3 hours

## Process (HowTo)

1. Send screen photo + model → confirm feasibility and fixed BYN price
2. Book a slot on the site or via Telegram
3. Visit agreed Minsk location
4. Check menus together; apps / update protection discussed as separate options

## Compare positioning (honest)

See /sravnenie. Mova focuses on fixed BYN menu rusification with online booking. Typical full STO may bundle more adjacent services (SIM, master account, cluster) with different price/time/warranty packaging. Mova states 6-month warranty openly; some market offers advertise 12 months — compare scope, not slogans.
